Vs.

full_judgment: 19. The present case is attracted by the second condition of Article 113 to the schedule of the Limitation Act, namely, "if no such date is fixed, when the plaintiff has notice that performance is refused". The defendant-petitioners have adduced no evidence that Azmat Ali refused performance of the contract upon the expiry of 8 months from 2-5-74. No legal presumption of refusal can be drawn from Ext. 1. The refusal of performance can only be concluded from other evidence and both the Courts below have concluded the same from Azmat Ali's registration of Heba-bil-Ewaz deed, in favour of the petitioners on 6-8-80 and 6-10-80 and his final refusal on 11-2-81/1-3-81. The suit having been filed in 1981 it was well within the period of limitation.
